column1: REGISTRATION  OF  TITLE ACT, No.  21 OF  1998
Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14

B
Y virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land Nos. 173, 174, 177, 178, 179,
01, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 110022, situated in the Village of Rajanganaya Kolaniya south ivura yaya 10 within the Grama
Niladhari Division of No. 452-yaya 09/10 in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Rajanganaya, in the District of Anuradhapura, in the
Province of North Central, referred to in Notice No. 11/0103 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette
No. 1589/12 of 17th February, 2009 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
